title: Parivahan - Transfer of Ownership (normal sale / death / auction)
notes: Form 29 by transferor; Form 30 by transferee within 14 days (same State) / 45 days (other State); document list; asterisked items may be required in some states; refs MVA s.50, CMVR r.55-57, fee r.81

title: Parivahan - Hypothecation Termination
notes: Form 35 signed by registered owner and financier; certificate of due clearance; repayment-failure case -> Form 36 RC in financier name; refs MVA s.51, CMVR r.61

title: Parivahan - Hypothecation Addition
notes: Form 34 signed by registered owner and financier = entry of hypothecation; refs MVA s.51, CMVR r.60

title: Parivahan - No Objection Certificate
notes: Form 28 when vehicle is removed or sold outside the registering authority's jurisdiction, within or outside the State; refs MVA s.48, CMVR r.54

title: Parivahan - Hypothecation Continuation user manual
notes: National VAHAN online service 'Hypothecation Continuation' exists (login, upload documents, pay fee). Does not state which states enable it; West Bengal availability not confirmed by an official WB source.

title: West Bengal Transport Department - FAQ
notes: Q9 transfer documents (apply at office where vehicle is registered; Form 34 and/or 35 in hypothecated cases); Q10 Form 34 endorsement / Form 35 deletion in duplicate with financier full-dues certificate

title: West Bengal Motor Vehicles Executive Officers' Association - Transfer of ownership FAQ
source_type: Secondary (association site; not a government source)
notes: States same-State transfer is intimated within 14 days; Form 29 signed by seller; Form 30 signed by seller and purchaser; Form 35 (2 copies) if hypothecation terminated, Form 34 (2 copies) if hypothecation endorsed. Use only as a pointer to what to confirm with the WB Transport Department.

title: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 50 (transfer of ownership)
notes: Text read from India Code mirror https://indiacode.ecourtsindia.com/mv-act/section/50/ (official India Code PDF returned 504 on 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-12). s.50(1)(a)(i) transferor reports within 14 days (same State) and simultaneously sends a copy to the transferee; s.50(1)(b) transferee reports within 30 days with RC, fee and transferor's report; s.50(3) late reporting -> RA may require an amount prescribed under s.50(5) in lieu of action under s.177; s.50(5) State may prescribe amounts by period of delay. Reviewer to confirm against official PDF.

title: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 51 (hypothecation / hire-purchase)
notes: Text read from Indian Kanoon https://indiankanoon.org/doc/187702/ and lawmaker.in. s.51(2) entry when the transferee enters a new agreement; s.51(3) entry cancelled on proof of termination; s.51(4) no transfer entry without written consent of the financier named in the RC; s.51(5) fresh RC to financier on owner default. Reviewer to confirm against official PDF.

title: General Clauses Act, 1897 - Section 9 (commencement and termination of time)
notes: s.9 says the word 'from' excludes the first day; MVA s.50 says 'within fourteen days of the transfer' ('of', not 'from'). Whether the day of transfer is excluded is an interpretation the reviewer or mentor must decide.

title: Form 29 - Notice of transfer of ownership (Rule 55(1))
notes: Downloaded to 02_Official_RTO_Sources/downloaded/Form29.pdf (scanned image). Text confirmed from search extraction of the Parivahan PDF and state copies (Rajasthan, Chandigarh, Goa): notice by registered owner (transferor) to the RA where the transferee resides; states RC and insurance handed over; financier signs 'as his consent' where the vehicle is under agreement; current Parivahan version allows digital/e-signature of owner or authorised dealer.

title: Form 30 - Application for intimation and transfer of ownership
notes: PDF downloaded to 02_Official_RTO_Sources/downloaded/Form30.pdf (scanned image); text read from VAHAN print version. Purchaser's declaration; made in duplicate if under hypothecation; 'Consent of the financier' section consenting to transfer to the transferee 'with whom I/We have bound into an agreement'; office endorsement records 'transfer of ownership under continuation of an endorsement of the hire-purchase/lease/hypothecation agreement'; enclosures: original RC, insurance, address proof, PUC, NOC from financier.

title: Form 34 - Entry of hypothecation agreement subsequent to registration (Rule 60)
notes: Downloaded and text extracted. Signed by registered owner (or person to be registered as owner) and financier; requests entry of the agreement in the RC; duplicate/triplicate returned to financier.

title: Form 35 - Notice of termination of hypothecation agreement (Rule 61(1))
notes: Downloaded and text extracted. Joint declaration that the agreement is terminated, requesting cancellation of the RC endorsement; signed by registered owner and financier (with official seal); RC and fee enclosed; made in duplicate (triplicate if original RA differs).
